items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Duke was having trouble with Otto Hardwick

ctx.x: minute. Now, that ain't bad. Their take, you know.... Because when you walk up there and you've got your pockets full of money...

Well, that's I think the first time... I think that's the first time I turned down Duke Ellington. Because at that time, he was having trouble with Otto, Johnny hadn't joined the band. He had tried to get Johnny; Johnny was with Chick...
